summary: Blue Moon Metals filed a 6-K attaching a September 14, 2026 press release disclosing a binding letter agreement dated September 11, 2026 among Blue Moon (TSXV: MOON; NASDAQ: BMM), The Elmet Group (NASDAQ: ELMT) and EQ Resources (ASX: EQR) for a US$150–$175 million investment into the Springer Tungsten Complex, Nevada. Transactions include an Elmet equity investment into Blue Moon, a JV owning/operating the APT plant, Elmet board representation in both entities, concentrate offtake and prepayment facilities. Terms, pricing and premium were not disclosed; no advisor named. Watch structuring, definitive documentation and financing risk.
